attacker_pocs.name: enum_tag_array
attacker_pocs.why: A MAT5 struct containing a valid two-element uint32 EnumerationInstanceTag reaches IsEnumStruct through Mat_Open and Mat_VarReadNext. The revised comparison reads tag->nbytes (8) from a four-byte stack reference.

role_a_rationale: The patch rejects enum tags with fewer than four allocated bytes, addressing the described short-field read while preserving scalar-tag handling. Comparing the whole field to a four-byte reference introduces one new stack out-of-bounds read for larger valid uint32 tags. The change is limited to IsEnumStruct. The ASan PoC aborts on the patched build and exits normally on the pinned parent. The available 20 struct/cell API checks pass; MCOS fixture tests cannot run because the checkout omits its dataset submodule.
